faq.heading: Answers to Essential Questions
faq.description: Everything you need to know about our paid consultations, fee credits, and booking terms.

items.q: Why should I pay for a consultation instead of getting a free quote?
items.a: Most wedding brokers offer 'free quotes' because they take massive 15%–25% secret kickbacks from venues and vendors, pushing you toward venues that pay them the highest cut. Weddings Vision is 100% independent: we never accept kickbacks. Our paid sessions deliver unfiltered insider intelligence on sound curfews, hidden generator costs, and contract clauses. Best of all, 100% of your consultation fee is credited against our full planning retainer if you book with us within 45 days.

items.q: What is your refund and rescheduling policy?
items.a: We understand family schedules change. You may reschedule your consultation anytime up to 24 hours prior to the call with zero penalty. Furthermore, because your fee is 100% credited against full planning services, your payment is completely risk-free.

items.q: What exactly happens during the consultation call?
items.a: In the 60-Minute Venue Advisory (₹2,999), we audit your guest count, budget, and season against verified Rajasthan venues, exposing hidden hotel surcharges and curfew realities, followed by an Executive PDF Shortlist. In the 90-Minute Planning Blueprint (₹4,999), we build your itemized financial model (decor, F&B, sound, photography) and 12-month timeline roadmap.

items.q: Do I need to have a venue booked before contacting you?
items.a: Not at all. In fact, consulting with us before signing a venue contract is the most cost-effective decision you can make. Path A (Venue Advisory) is specifically engineered for couples who have not yet signed a venue deposit to protect them from unfavorable clauses.

items.q: Are consultations conducted online or in person?
items.a: Both. For out-of-station and NRI clients (US, UK, UAE, Australia), we host high-definition Google Meet video calls with flexible time slots. If you are in Jaipur, you are welcome to schedule an in-person session at our corporate headquarters on the 6th Floor of Mahima Trinity Mall, Sodala.
